verdict.rationale: Shopify documents a public, protocol-based API surface for agents: UCP-compliant JSON-RPC MCP endpoints for Global Catalog, Storefront Catalog, Cart, Checkout and Order, with named tools, auth tiers, schemas and a CLI wrapper. Runtime probes confirmed live handshakes and keyless cart creation on a real store, and the open UCP spec is published. Missing for 10: no OpenAPI/machine-readable REST spec (probes 404), checkout completion and order reads not verified hands-on and gated to the Token tier, and order-webhook subscription not self-serve (requires a partner manager).
